Holder Identity

Rank System

Your wallet defines your role. Ranks unlock progressively as you engage with the ecosystem.

IWatcherEntry-level community observer.
IIHolderVerified token holder.
IIILoyal HolderConsistent holder with deeper access.
IVGenesis HolderEarly supporter with stronger ecosystem identity.
VRyujin GuardHigh-loyalty member protecting community direction.
VIOmikami Inner CircleTop-tier access for future ecosystem benefits.
